scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,UI,ELECTRON -c cyan,magenta,blue "npm run backend:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 tcp:127.0.0.1:8765 && npm --prefix frontend run electron:dev"
scripts.test: node scripts/run-python.cjs -m pytest backend/tests -q && npm --prefix frontend run lint
